suggestions: I'm grateful for a deploy that went out clean on a Friday afternoon and let me actually enjoy the weekend.
I'm thankful for the ten minutes of quiet before Fajr when even the mosquitoes seem to be asleep.
I'm grateful for teh tarik that hit exactly right on a day I badly needed it to.
I'm thankful for my dad texting "dah makan?" and somehow always asking at the exact moment I haven't.
I'm grateful for catching a race condition in staging instead of finding out about it from a Slack ping at 2am.
I'm thankful for the rain starting right after I parked the car, not five minutes before.
I'm grateful for a payslip landing on time this month when half my friends are talking about hiring freezes.
I'm thankful for my grandmother still asking about my work even though she has no idea what a bug is.
I'm grateful for a senior dev who explained the legacy code instead of just telling me to figure it out.
I'm thankful for finding parking near the surau on a Friday without circling the block three times.
I'm grateful for a standup that actually ended in fifteen minutes like it was supposed to.
I'm thankful for pisang goreng from the stall downstairs still being warm when I grabbed it after work.
I'm grateful for a laptop fan that finally stopped sounding like it's about to take off.
I'm thankful for a friend who called just to talk nonsense for twenty minutes on a rough day.
I'm grateful for waking up before the alarm and having a few unhurried minutes before the day starts pulling at me.
